ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Permission.Bypass_Validate_Plan_Activation_Date ) , NOT( ISBLANK( Plan_Activation__c ) ) , ISBLANK( PRIORVALUE( Plan_Activation__c ) ) , OR( ( DAY( Plan_Activation__c ) != 1 ) , ( TEXT( Status ) != "Reviewed" ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Plan Activation date must be the first day of the month and can only be set when Order status is "Reviewed"
